{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Filter out sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
valid_baseline = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate patients by keeping highest sample_seq per patient
# Sort by sample_seq descending, then drop duplicates on patient_id
deduplicated = valid_baseline.sort_values(by='sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Step 3: Compute mean baseline biomarker value
mean_baseline = deduplicated['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

print(f'Number of valid baseline values (after removing -999): {len(valid_baseline)}')
print(f'Number of patients after deduplication: {len(deduplicated)}')
print(f'Mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL): {mean_baseline:.2f}')"}
